The first data point for the orange 'Perplexity' line is at a Recent Sequence Ratio of approximately 10%, not 0%.
The blue 'GPU Mem. Ratio' line starts at a Recent Sequence Ratio of approximately 10% (not 0%) and ends at 100% (not 95%) when the ratio is 100%.
The dashed red line for 'Full Cache PPL' is at a constant perplexity value of approximately 4.38, which is visibly below the 4.4 tick mark.
